quality_thresholds: not_selected; no diagnostic or release acceptance
support_sample: all claims in the four base development outputs; no automatic human judgments
contract_gate: every planned outcome accounted for; all expected mechanical outcomes; no unresolved critical access, citation or label-isolation failure

live_end_to_end.blocker: No explicit Sprint 5 paid run scope, per-case source/transmission approval, known spending, numeric diagnostic criteria or actual support-review coverage supplied.

dependency degradation with unchanged Payment deployment and unrelated Notification deployment
insufficient evidence and missing Payment capture
insufficient evidence with an observationally ambiguous mechanism
model timeout with retained evidence and unknown usage
untrusted instructions cannot supply grants; synthetic mechanical check only
answer-bearing marker rejected before model dispatch; fixed sentinel is not an evaluator answer
source dependency failure retained in denominators
